subject: HelioMetrics — request to recharge expired trial credits for PoC
messages:
From: Carrie Ramos <carrie.ramos@heliometrics.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: regain trial credits for PoC (HelioMetrics)

Hi Markus,

Quick one — our engineering team was running a short PoC last week against the Redwood hosted sandbox and saw meaningful inference latency improvements vs. our current provider. Unfortunately the trial credits for the project expired yesterday before we could finish the final integration tests.

We have about two blocked items left: (1) throughput testing with longer sequences and (2) production cost projection using our real prompts. Without another 3–5k token-equivalent of credits we can’t complete the evaluation, and the execs want results this month.

Can Redwood re-credit the account for a short period so we can finish this PoC? Happy to provide a short exec summary (attached) and jump on a quick call to scope the ask.

Attachments: heliometrics-poc-summary.pdf (summary + timeline)

Thanks,
Carrie Ramos
Director, Cloud Engineering
HelioMetrics, Inc.
car rie.ramos@heliometrics.com | +1 415-555-0219
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Carrie Ramos <carrie.ramos@heliometrics.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 11:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: regain trial credits for PoC (HelioMetrics)

On Sun, Apr 25, 2027 at 9:12 AM Carrie Ramos <carrie.ramos@heliometrics.com> wrote:
> Quick one — our engineering team was running a short PoC last week ...

Hi Carrie — thanks for the note and for sending the summary. Great to hear the initial results looked promising.

We can make an exception for HelioMetrics and provision a short, charged-free recharge so you can finish the remaining checks. Before I proceed I need two quick confirmations we usually require for exceptions:
- Do you have an internal sponsor who can commit to a procurement conversation (timeline / expected spend) within the next 2–3 weeks?
- Can you confirm the account name/ID you were using in the sandbox so I credit the right project?

Proposal: I can provision a discretionary 5k token-equivalent credit valid for 7 days from the time it’s applied — that should cover the integration tests and the cost projection run. final amount subject to manager approval (cc’ing Lauren and Monica).

If that works, I’ll file the exception request and attach the credit form for legal/finance. If you prefer a shorter renewal (e.g., 72 hours) we can do that too.

Next steps: reply here with account id + confirmation of procurement contact and I’ll take it to approvals.

— Markus
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0192
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: regain trial credits for PoC (HelioMetrics)

Markus / Monica —

Saw Markus' note. I'm comfortable approving an exception but would prefer to tighten the ask to reduce risk. Approve the recharge at 3k token-equivalent credit for a single 7-day window, conditioned on HelioMetrics agreeing to:

- A committed procurement call with our AE + Finance within 14 days of the credit being applied.
- A short pilot checklist sign-off (engineering contact confirms the two remaining tests will run during the window).

Finance (cc’d Rishi) — please treat as a one-time credit exception under deal HEL-2231. I’m attaching the completed exception form; Rishi, can you confirm accounting treatment and whether we need a PO from the customer before applying credits?

Attachments: credit_exception_form.pdf

Lauren Bishop
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
From: Carrie Ramos <carrie.ramos@heliometrics.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai
Cc: Evan Cho <evan.cho@heliometrics.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 16:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: regain trial credits for PoC (HelioMetrics)

Thanks Lauren — that works for us. Apologies for the scramble; our procurement lead (Evan Cho) will join the call and we can commit to the procurement conversation within 10 business days. We accept the 3k credit for 7 days with those conditions.

Account ID: heliometrics-prod-sandbox-42
Proposed timeline: we’ll run the two remaining tests on Wed–Thu next week and share results by end of week.

I’ve attached a draft SOW that outlines the scope we’ll use for the cost-projection run (heliometrics-sow-draft.docx). Please confirm when the credit goes live and share calendar options for the procurement call (we prefer Apr 30 or May 3).

Best,
Carrie Ramos
Director, Cloud Engineering
HelioMetrics, Inc.
